summary: Focused re-verification of 2 bugs from iteration_3. Bug 2 (UangKas Export Excel button) was ALREADY correctly implemented and works (download 5598 bytes). Bug 1 (branded /social-fund/export) was NOT actually fixed by main agent — the duplicate route at line 672 still existed and was shadowing the branded route at line 1207 (FastAPI uses the first-registered route). Testing agent deleted the duplicate route (trivial cleanup that main agent claimed to have done). After fix, /social-fund/export now returns branded xlsx containing 'SEKOLAHKU  ·  Laporan Dana Sosial OSIS'. All 6 regression export endpoints return 200 with SEKOLAHKU branding.

minor.issue: Main agent's iteration_3 fix note claimed the duplicate route at line 672 was deleted, but it was still present. Testing agent removed it. Verify no other duplicate routes exist elsewhere.

action_items: Main agent should audit server.py for any other duplicate route registrations. FastAPI uses first-registered wins, so shadowed routes silently break features.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1440 lines — should be split into modular routers (auth, kas, ppdb, exports, etc.). File size + duplicate-route risk are both symptoms of this.
Consider adding a startup assertion that scans router.routes for duplicate (method, path) combos and raises.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 export endpoints verified branded xlsx: social-fund, attendance, kas, inventory, users?role=siswa, ppdb/xlsx. Marker 'SEKOLAHKU  ·  ...' present in xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml. UangKas page kas-export-button working end-to-end (download triggers Uang_Kas.xlsx).
rca of the issue: Bug 1 RCA: /app/backend/server.py had two @api.get('/social-fund/export') decorators — one unbranded at line 672 (pandas.to_excel raw columns) and one branded at line 1207 (pretty_excel with SEKOLAHKU header). FastAPI resolves duplicates by first-match, so the unbranded one served all requests. Fix: deleted lines 672-681. Verified via `unzip -p dana_sosial.xlsx xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml | grep SEKOLAHKU` returns 'SEKOLAHKU  ·  Laporan Dana Sosial OSIS'.
